CustomField.description: Works with the Contact matching used during conversion in the Form_Submission_Convert_Upsert_Contact_Overridable flow. When matching returns multiple Contact candidates, enabling this updates the highest-confidence match instead of skipping it or creating a duplicate; leave it off to require a single unambiguous match.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When your matching rules return multiple Contact matches during conversion, update the highest-confidence match instead of skipping it or creating a duplicate. Leave it off to require a single unambiguous match before any update is made.
CustomField.label: Update Most Confident (Contact)
